title: City Health Campaign: Choosing the Right Audience
instructions: 本材料为原创模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试，也不代表任何分数。先听/读对话，注意倍数与比例表达、比较结构、过去和现在数据的时态选择。完成10道听力题后，学习语法讲解并做8道语法题，最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有答案依据原文，NOT GIVEN题需说明缺失信息。
transcript:
Maya: Hi, Daniel. Thanks for coming. We need to plan the new city health campaign. The council wants to reach more people this year.
Daniel: Sure. What do we know about last year's campaign?
Maya: Last year we focused on young adults. We reached about 2,000 people. This year we have a bigger budget, so we can reach three times as many people.
Daniel: Three times as many? So 6,000 people?
Maya: Yes, 6,000. But the budget is only twice as big as last year's. So we must be careful.
Daniel: Right. Who should we target? Young adults again?
Maya: The data shows young adults are still important. But older people are now a larger group. Last year, people over 60 were 15 percent of the audience. This year, they are 25 percent.
Daniel: That's a big change. So we should include older people.
Maya: Exactly. But we also need to think about families. Families with children are 30 percent of the city population now. Last year, they were 20 percent.
Daniel: So families are one and a half times more common than before?
Maya: Yes, that's right. One and a half times. So we need materials for families too.
Daniel: What about the budget for each group? Last year we spent 50 percent on young adults. This year, we plan to spend 40 percent on young adults, 30 percent on older people, and 30 percent on families.
Maya: Good. But wait, last year we spent 50 percent on young adults and 50 percent on other groups. This year the total is 100 percent, but the groups are different.
Daniel: Yes. The young adult share is smaller, but the total budget is larger. So the money for young adults is still more than last year.
Maya: Let's check. Last year's budget was $10,000. This year it is $20,000. So 40 percent of $20,000 is $8,000. Last year, 50 percent of $10,000 was $5,000. So we are spending more on young adults, even though the percentage is lower.
Daniel: That's interesting. The percentage went down, but the amount went up.
Maya: Exactly. We need to explain that clearly in the report.
Daniel: What about the number of events? Last year we had 10 events. This year we plan to have 15 events. That's one and a half times as many.
Maya: Yes. And we want more people at each event. Last year, about 200 people came to each event. This year, we hope for 300 people at each event.
Daniel: So 15 events times 300 people is 4,500 people. But we said 6,000 people total.
Maya: Right. The 6,000 includes online reach. Online reach was 1,000 last year. This year we hope for 1,500 online.
Daniel: So 4,500 at events plus 1,500 online is 6,000. That works.
Maya: Good. Now, who will write the report?
Daniel: I can write it. But I need the exact numbers.
Maya: I'll send them today. And remember, the campaign starts next month.
Daniel: Got it. I'll start the draft tomorrow.

grammar.title: 倍数与比例表达；比较结构；过去和现在数据的时态选择
grammar.explanation: 英语中表达倍数常用：twice as ... as（是……的两倍）、three times as ... as（是……的三倍）、one and a half times as ... as（是……的一点五倍）。比例用 percent of ... 表示“百分之……”。比较结构常用 more ... than（比……更多）、less ... than（比……更少）、as ... as（和……一样）。描述数据时，过去的数据用一般过去时（last year we spent...），现在的数据用一般现在时（this year we plan...），变化可用 went up / went down。注意：百分比下降不代表总量下降，要结合总数判断。
grammar.example: This year we have a bigger budget, so we can reach three times as many people.

questions.prompt: Last year the club had 40 members. This year it has 80. This year the club has ______ members.
options: one and a half times as many
questions.evidence: Last year the club had 40 members. This year it has 80.

questions.prompt: In 2020, 20 percent of students walked to school. Now, 30 percent walk. The percentage ______.
questions.explanation: 从20%到30%是上升，用 went up。
questions.evidence: In 2020, 20 percent of students walked to school. Now, 30 percent walk.

questions.prompt: The new library is ______ the old one. It is 1.5 times bigger.
options: one and a half times as big as
answers: one and a half times as big as
questions.explanation: 1.5倍用 one and a half times as big as。

questions.prompt: Last year we ______ 500 books. This year we ______ 800 books.
questions.explanation: 去年用过去时 sold，今年用现在时 sell。
questions.evidence: Last year we sold 500 books. This year we sell 800 books.

questions.prompt: The number of cars in the city is now ______ than in 2010.
questions.evidence: The number of cars in the city is now more than in 2010.

questions.prompt: This year, 25 percent of the budget ______ for health. Last year, it ______ 20 percent.
questions.explanation: 今年用 is，去年用 was。
questions.evidence: This year, 25 percent of the budget is for health. Last year, it was 20 percent.

questions.prompt: The new phone is ______ the old phone. It costs three times as much as the old phone.
options: one and a half times as expensive as
questions.explanation: 三倍用 three times as expensive as。
questions.evidence: It costs three times as much as the old phone.

questions.prompt: In 2015, the city had 10 parks. Now it has 15 parks. The number of parks is ______.
options: one and a half times as many
answers: one and a half times as many
questions.explanation: 15是10的1.5倍，用 one and a half times as many。
questions.evidence: In 2015, the city had 10 parks. Now it has 15 parks.
